defs.d: To harmonize in opinion, statement, or action; to be in unison or concord; to be or become united or consistent; to concur.
defs.ex: all parties agree in the expediency of the law.

defs.d: To yield assent; to accede;—followed by to.
defs.ex: to agree to an offer, or to opinion.

defs.d: Coming, arrival; approach.
Semen
To move from further away to nearer to.
defs.ex: She’ll be coming ’round the mountain when she comes [...]

defs.d: To arrive.
Used to indicate a point in time at or after which a stated event or situation occurs.
defs.ex: Come retirement, their Social Security may turn out to be a lot less than they counted on.

defs.d: A piece of nonfictional writing such as a story, report, opinion piece, or entry in a newspaper, magazine, journal, dictionary, encyclopedia, etc.
An object, a member of a group or class.
defs.ex: a sales article

defs.d: To bind by articles of apprenticeship.
defs.ex: to article an apprentice to a mechanic

defs.d: To accuse or charge by an exhibition of articles or accusations.
The arts, customs, lifestyles, background, and habits that characterize a particular society or nation.
The beliefs, values, behaviour and material objects that constitute a people's way of life.
To maintain in an environment suitable for growth (especially of bacteria) (compare cultivate)
To increase the artistic or scientific interest (in something) (compare cultivate)
A wealthy or privileged person.
One who has some (contextually specified) thing.
To possess, own.
defs.ex: I have a house and a car.

defs.d: To hold, as something at someone's disposal.
defs.ex: Do you have the key? (not necessarily one's own key)

defs.d: A body of words, and set of methods of combining them (called a grammar), understood by a community and used as a form of communication.
defs.ex: Deaf and mute people communicate using languages like ASL.

defs.d: The ability to communicate using words.
defs.ex: the gift of language

defs.d: To communicate by language; to express in language.
(abstract) This place; this location.
defs.ex: An Alzheimer patient's here may in his mind be anywhere he called home in the time he presently re-lives.

defs.d: (abstract) This time, the present situation.
Filler after a noun or demonstrative pronoun, solely for emphasis.
defs.ex: John here is a rascal.

defs.d: Filler after a demonstrative pronoun but before the noun it modifies, solely for emphasis.
defs.ex: This here orange is too sour.

defs.d: (location) In, on, or at this place.
defs.ex: Flu season is here.

defs.d: (location) To this place; used in place of the more dated hither.
defs.ex: Please come here.

defs.d: Honorific alternative letter-case form of his, sometimes used when referring to God or another important figure who is understood from context.
That which belongs to him; the possessive case of he, used without a following noun.
defs.ex: The decision was his to live with.

defs.d: A structure built or serving as an abode of human beings.
defs.ex: This is my house and my family's ancestral home.

defs.d: The people who live in a house; a household.
To be in the habit of choosing something rather than something else; to favor; to like better.
defs.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.

defs.d: To advance, promote (someone or something).
An instance of riding.
defs.ex: Can I have a ride on your bike?

defs.d: A vehicle.
defs.ex: That's a nice ride; what did it cost?

defs.d: To transport oneself by sitting on and directing a horse, later also a bicycle etc.
To be transported in a vehicle; to travel as a passenger.
An implement consisting of multiple more or less flexible bristles or other filaments attached to a handle, used for any of various purposes including cleaning, painting, and arranging hair.
The act of brushing something.
defs.ex: She gave her hair a quick brush.

defs.d: To clean with a brush.
defs.ex: Brush your teeth.

defs.d: To untangle or arrange with a brush.
defs.ex: Brush your hair.

defs.d: A rural habitation of size between a hamlet and a town.
defs.ex: There are 2 churches and 3 shops in our village.

defs.d: A rural habitation that has a church, but no market.
A company that flies airplanes to transport people and goods.
A composite material consisting largely of calcium phosphate and collagen and making up the skeleton of most vertebrates.
Any of the components of an endoskeleton, made of bone.
To prepare (meat, etc) by removing the bone or bones from.
To fertilize with bone.
Of an off-white colour, like the colour of bone.
Large movable item(s), usually in a room, which enhance(s) the room's characteristics, functionally or decoratively.
defs.ex: A chair is furniture. Sofas are also furniture.

defs.d: The harness, trappings etc. of a horse, hawk, or other animal.
Conversation or debate concerning a particular topic.
defs.ex: My discussion with the professor was very enlightening.

defs.d: Text giving further detail on a subject.
defs.ex: Under each heading, you will find a discussion.

defs.d: Closed, shut.
Narrow; confined.
defs.ex: a close alley; close quarters

defs.d: The act or time of shutting; close.
defs.ex: the shut of a door

defs.d: A door or cover; a shutter.
To close, to stop from being open.
defs.ex: Please shut the door.

defs.d: To close, to stop being open.
defs.ex: If you wait too long, the automatic door will shut.

defs.d: One who makes prints.
The operator of a printing press, or the owner of a printing business.
The act of biting.
The wound left behind after having been bitten.
defs.ex: That snake bite really hurts!

defs.d: To cut into something by clamping the teeth.
defs.ex: As soon as you bite that sandwich, you'll know how good it is.

defs.d: To hold something by clamping one's teeth.
Decomposition into components in order to study (a complex thing, concept, theory etc.).
The result of such a process.
In the direction of.
defs.ex: She moved toward the door.

defs.d: In relation to (someone or something).
defs.ex: What are your feelings toward him?

defs.d: Near; at hand; in state of preparation; toward.
In the direction of something (indicated by context).
To consume (a liquid) through the mouth.
defs.ex: He drank the water I gave him.

defs.d: (metonymic) To consume the liquid contained within (a bottle, glass, etc.).
defs.ex: Jack drank the whole bottle by himself.

defs.d: One who is intoxicated with alcohol.
A habitual drinker, especially one who is frequently intoxicated.
Intoxicated as a result of excessive alcohol consumption, usually by drinking alcoholic beverages.
Habitually or frequently in a state of intoxication.
Excess of material, useless by-products or damaged, unsaleable products; garbage; rubbish.
Excrement or urine.
defs.ex: The cage was littered with animal waste

defs.d: For that or this purpose, referring to something previously stated.
Consequently, by or in consequence of that or this cause; referring to something previously stated.
defs.ex: Traditional values will always have a place, therefore they will never lose relevance.

defs.d: The ring-shaped protective covering around a wheel which is usually made of rubber or plastic composite and is either pneumatic or solid.
The metal rim of a wheel, especially that of a railway vehicle.
To fit tyres to (a vehicle).
A controlled behaviour; self-control.
A specific branch of knowledge or learning.
To train someone by instruction and practice.
To teach someone to obey authority.
The part of a plant, generally underground, that anchors and supports the plant body, absorbs and stores water and nutrients, and in some plants is able to perform vegetative reproduction.
defs.ex: This tree's roots can go as deep as twenty metres underground.

defs.d: A root vegetable.
To grow roots; to enter the earth, as roots; to take root and begin to grow.
defs.ex: The cuttings are starting to root.

defs.d: To prepare, oversee, or otherwise cause the rooting of cuttings
defs.ex: We rooted some cuttings last summer.

defs.d: A store or supply.
The capital raised by a company through the issue of shares. The total of shares held by an individual shareholder.
To have on hand for sale.
defs.ex: The store stocks all kinds of dried vegetables.

defs.d: To provide with material requisites; to store; to fill; to supply.
defs.ex: to stock a farm, i.e. to supply it with cattle and tools

defs.d: Of a type normally available for purchase/in stock.
defs.ex: stock items

defs.d: (racing, of a race car) Having the same configuration as cars sold to the non-racing public, or having been modified from such a car.
(often in plural) An amount of money paid to a worker for a specified quantity of work, usually calculated on an hourly basis and expressed in an amount of money per hour.
defs.ex: Before her promotion, her wages were 20% less.
